issues.critique: Source span-43 defines 子会社 by reference to the Companies Act and expressly says that meaning is the same in 第四十九条第一項第一号ハ. Target Article 49 span-28 defines 子会社 via 法第百六十六条第五項. Both USES_DEFINITION conditions are therefore established; the Worker negative is unsupported.
issues.recommendedAction: Reconsider USES_DEFINITION as established and add an assertion using this occurrence hash, source span-43, target span-28, with source as SUBJECT and target as OBJECT.
